purpose: Qualify the temporal fidelity of an R2 transfer logger/package on dummy substrates before using logged temperature/RH/acceleration to interpret qualified-device transfers.

thermal_rh_fit.independence_note: Repeated samples inside a run do not increase independent run count.

sampling_rule.decision_rule: Use the smallest qualified temperature/RH time constant across directions, dummy placements, and runs; the transfer-log gap must not exceed one fifth of that value.
sampling_rule.note: The factor 5 is a provisional engineering sampling-density rule, not a device-safety standard. It must remain labeled as an assumption until justified by application-specific reconstruction/error requirements.

acceleration_pulse_screen.decision_rule: All tested pulse-width groups must have conservative lower peak-capture ratio >=0.90; otherwise acceleration evidence is bandwidth-incomplete for impulses at or below the failed width.

uncertainty.temperature_rh_tau: Report fitted tau with bootstrap or run-to-run interval; systematic reference timing and sensor placement terms separately.
uncertainty.acceleration: For each pulse use conservative ratio R_lower=(A_logger-u_logger)/(A_ref+u_ref), bounded below by zero.
uncertainty.correlation_note: Shared calibration/timebase terms must not be treated as independent repeats.

classification.QUALIFIED_FOR_DECLARED_BANDWIDTH: Required provenance, independent runs, fit diagnostics, uncertainty fields and acceleration pulse screens pass.
classification.INCOMPLETE: Missing provenance, insufficient independent runs, invalid/nonphysical fit, missing uncertainty, or untested required pulse width.
classification.FAIL_BANDWIDTH: A required temperature/RH fit is invalid for the declared model or an acceleration pulse group fails the conservative peak-capture criterion.

claim_boundary: Passing this protocol establishes only logger/package temporal-fidelity evidence over the tested dummy configuration and perturbation range. It does not establish device stability, shipping safety, facility equivalence, or any quantum mechanism.
